name: Entrance Hall
description: The main lobby where every visit begins. Tickets, information desk, and the central corridor to all wings.

name: Antiquities Gallery
description: Greek and Roman antiquities, including sculpture, reliefs, and military artifacts.

name: Renaissance Gallery
description: Paintings and decorative arts from the Renaissance and early modern periods.

name: Egyptian Wing
description: Artifacts and objects from the river kingdoms of the ancient world.

name: Central Atrium
description: An open rotunda connecting the upper galleries with the lower halls.

name: Modern Art Wing
description: Twentieth-century painting, abstraction, and contemporary works.

name: Natural History Hall
description: Fossils, minerals, and specimens from the natural world.

name: Science Pavilion
description: Instruments of discovery: navigation, astronomy, and early technology.

name: Cafe & Gift Shop
description: Rest, refreshments, and the museum gift shop near the east exit.
